findings.evidence: The first two declarations use only point actions, `AlgHom.mapDomain`, and comodule corestriction; the third uses only `isSemisimplePoint_def`, `pointsAction_corestrict`, and `FGComoduleCat.corestrict`. The first Jordan-specific reference is `eq_jordanDecomposition_iff` at line 133.
findings.fix: Move the two action lemmas to an earlier representation/corestriction module near `PointsAction`, and move `IsSemisimplePoint.mapDomain` beside `IsSemisimplePoint`; leave only the Jordan-factor naturality declarations in this module and adjust imports.
findings.issue: `endOfPoint_corestrict`, `pointsAction_corestrict` (line 89), and `IsSemisimplePoint.mapDomain` (line 111) do not depend on Jordan decomposition and are broadly useful lower-level results, but their current location forces users to import the later Jordan/Tannakian theory.

summary: Generic point-action/corestriction and semisimple-point naturality results are misplaced under Jordan decomposition.
